seed: A track on the timeline lifts by its header the way a layer row does: pressed and moved, the whole track (header and lane) rides the pointer, the other tracks slide aside, and it lands in the gap they open, in one undo step; Escape puts it back. At Next defaults, no flag set. A recording with a title over it and music under it: V1 is carried above Title (and the layers list follows), the music's track is carried above the recording's own sound (and each sound stays on its track), a carry is called off with Escape, and Cmd-Z takes the last move back.

steps.note: a title over the recording, the recording's own sound under it, and music on a track of its own
THE FIRST TEST: V1 lifted by its header, header and lane together, Title slid down out of its way, and V1 landed in the gap on top; the recording is now in front of the title in the layers list too
THE SECOND TEST: the music's track carried above the recording's sound, and each sound went with its own track rather than the names swapping over sound that stayed put
THE THIRD TEST: Title lifted and carried over V1, then Escape: it went back where it came from and nothing changed
THE FOURTH TEST: one Cmd-Z takes the music's move back whole
